key_insight: GraphBEAT turns sparse, irregular EHR timelines into time-bucketed graphs to improve early gastrointestinal cancer risk stratification.
clinical_relevance: This could help flag higher-risk patients months earlier using routinely collected diagnoses and lab results, potentially supporting earlier diagnostic workup.
method: Groups longitudinal EHR events into time buckets
Builds temporally directed patient graphs with feature, value, and time-position nodes
Uses time-decay message passing plus multi-head attention pooling to produce patient-level risk representations
evidence_signal: Trained and tested on multi-site longitudinal diagnosis codes and laboratory tests, GraphBEAT outperformed GraphSAGE, GAT, GCN, Transformer, and LSTM at 12-, 24-, and 36-month lead times.
watch_item: Performance was shown in retrospective EHR data, so prospective validation and careful site-specific calibration would be needed before deployment.
paper_title: GraphBEAT: Graph-based Bucketized Event Aggregation Over Time for Early Risk Stratification of Gastrointestinal Cancers
